style.typography: Use Inter, Arial, Helvetica, or system sans-serif. Avoid decorative AI dashboard fonts.
design_principles: Use the airport background as a visual layer, not as data.
Overlay data UI in Figma/p5.js for crisp readable text.
Keep the large split-flap number in the upper half.
Keep travelers in the lower half, moving toward ARRIVALS.
